missing: None of the sources names a NAS to buy. The shopper still needs specific models with current prices, plus what Paperless-ngx needs to run on them: enough RAM and CPU for OCR (and whether x86 or ARM matters), Docker support, a drive mirror (RAID 1) and backups so the documents last for years.
why: This search is open. No major reviewer looks at NAS hardware for Paperless-ngx. The official docs and GitHub pages explain how to install it, but none of them recommends a device or says how much RAM, CPU or storage it needs. The other results are container listicles, personal config files and blank pages. A focused page comparing Docker-capable NASes on price, RAM, CPU and drive mirroring for an OCR archive, ending with a clear pick, would face no real competition.
